options.name: backup
options.description: If set, create a backup of the crontab before it is modified. The location of the backup is returned in the C(backup) variable by this module.

options.name: cron_file
options.description: If specified, uses this file instead of an individual user's crontab. Without a leading V(/), this is assumed to be in C(/etc/cron.d). With a leading V(/), this is taken as absolute.

options.name: insertafter
options.description: If specified, the variable is inserted after the variable specified. Used with O(state=present).

options.name: insertbefore
options.description: Used with O(state=present). If specified, the variable is inserted just before the variable specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to ensure that the variable is present or absent.

options.name: user
options.description: The specific user whose crontab should be modified. This parameter defaults to V(root) when unset.

options.name: value
options.description: The value to set this variable to. Required if O(state=present).
